role.description: What this machine does: "local" = host+client on one machine (default), "host" = owns tmux/sessions/daemon/bridge/inbox, "client" = human-facing terminal attaching to a remote host. Absent ⇒ inferred from platform and terminal.defaultTarget; set explicitly to pin it.

roots.description: Directories scanned one level deep for canonical Git repositories.

priority.description: Repository names pinned to the top of Claude0 lists.

imagePasteKey.description: Client role, macOS: hotkey of the image-paste Service — modifiers cmd/ctrl/alt/shift plus one key (default "cmd+shift+v"). The terminal must leave the chord unbound.

repoAbbreviations.description: Repo name → short display name on tmux window names and the sidebar (e.g. {"claude0": "c0"}). Lists, grouping, and push labels keep the real name.

terminalBundleId.description: macOS bundle id a notification click raises (terminal-notifier -activate). Omit for the Ghostty default; empty string disables -activate.

pushContact.description: VAPID contact (mailto: or https:) identifying you to Web Push services. Empty or omitted: derived from `git config user.email`.

popup.description: Opens the Claude0 popup. tmux notation: "prefix a" = prefix table; bare "M-x" = no-prefix (root) table, modifier required. Key tokens are letters/digits only (named keys like Up/BSpace/F5 included). Changes apply on the next `claude0 setup` run.

next.description: Switches to the next attention session (claude0 next). Changes apply on the next `claude0 setup` run.

sidebarFocus.description: Focuses the inbox sidebar pane. Changes apply after a `claude0 daemon` restart.

sidebarToggle.description: Shows/hides the inbox sidebar. Changes apply after a `claude0 daemon` restart.
